value_policy: Every retained scientific cell is an exact string. Empty source cells remain empty strings. No numeric, missing-value or categorical normalization is applied.

fields.name: candidate_id
fields.description: Neutral release row identifier, assigned in original source order; replaces the source UUID.

fields.name: chr5
fields.description: Source 5-prime partner chromosome label; coordinate reference is not declared in the table.

fields.name: bp5
fields.description: Source 5-prime breakpoint value, kept as text; coordinate convention is not independently established.

fields.name: chr3
fields.description: Source 3-prime partner chromosome label; coordinate reference is not declared in the table.

fields.name: bp3
fields.description: Source 3-prime breakpoint value, kept as text; coordinate convention is not independently established.

fields.name: gene5
fields.description: Source 5-prime gene label.

fields.name: gene3
fields.description: Source 3-prime gene label.

fields.name: transcript5
fields.description: Source 5-prime transcript label.

fields.name: transcript3
fields.description: Source 3-prime transcript label.

fields.name: exon5
fields.description: Source 5-prime exon value; original decimal formatting is retained.

fields.name: exon3
fields.description: Source 3-prime exon value; original decimal formatting is retained.

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Source candidate effect label; no new interpretation.

fields.name: direct_support
fields.description: Source direct-support field; precise counting definition is not supplied.

fields.name: discordant_support
fields.description: Source discordant-support field; precise counting definition is not supplied.

fields.name: total_support
fields.description: Source total-support field; not asserted to count unique molecules or independent evidence.

fields.name: fusion_caller
fields.description: Source caller label, including combined labels separated by a vertical bar; versions and parameters are not supplied.

fields.name: merged_fusions
fields.description: Source merged-fusions field; its precise definition is not supplied.

fields.name: reportable
fields.description: Source reportable flag, preserved literally. Every row has the value 0; no independent clinical validation is asserted.

fields.name: whitelist
fields.description: Source whitelist flag, preserved literally. Every row has the value 0; no independent meaning beyond the source label is assigned.

fields.name: topology
fields.description: Source topology label; no new interpretation.

fields.name: classification
fields.description: Source classification label. Every row is not_matched; no diagnostic meaning is inferred.

fields.name: transcript5_refseq
fields.description: Source 5-prime RefSeq transcript label, or original empty string.

fields.name: transcript3_refseq
fields.description: Source 3-prime RefSeq transcript label, or original empty string.

clinical_interpretation: Candidate caller output only. Presence of a row is not confirmation of a biological fusion, tumour specificity, clinical reportability or actionability.
